data.name: Roadside Store Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Roadside Store Simulator is a detailed simulation game where you build, manage and expand your own roadside general store from the ground up.

Every customer who walks through your door becomes part of your story. Stock shelves, operate the cash register, organize deliveries and keep your customers satisfied while transforming a small roadside shop into a thriving business.

As your store grows, so do the daily responsibilities. Hire cashiers, cleaners, warehouse workers and managers to keep operations running smoothly. Stay fully hands-on or step back and manage the system you’ve created.

Order products from wholesalers, track shipments and manage inventory carefully. Smart planning keeps shelves full and profits growing while poor stock management can lead to empty shelves and lost customers.

Customize your store exactly the way you want. Rearrange shelves, organize storage areas, place furniture and optimize customer flow to improve efficiency and create the perfect shopping experience.

Customers behave differently throughout the day. Some shop quickly for essentials, others spend time browsing and busy rush hours can put your management skills to the test. Changing customer flow and daily store rhythms create a dynamic and immersive gameplay experience.

Roadside Store Simulator combines cozy, relaxing gameplay with deep business management systems. Over time, your roadside store becomes more than just a shop. It becomes a living business shaped entirely by your decisions.

✨ KEY FEATURES

  • Build and manage your own roadside general store

  • Stock shelves, operate checkout counters and serve customers

  • Hire and manage employees including cashiers, cleaners, warehouse workers and managers

  • Order products, manage deliveries and track inventory

  • Expand storage areas and optimize warehouse operations

  • Fully customize your store layout, shelving and furniture placement

  • Improve store efficiency and customer satisfaction through smart organization

  • Dynamic customer behaviors and changing daily customer flow

  • Upgrade and expand your business over time

  • Cozy atmosphere combined with deep simulation mechanics

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel i3 7th, AMD Ryzen 1xxx series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 or RX 550
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Integrated GPUs require additional 2GB of system RAM. These estimates may change in the final release.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel i5 7th, AMD Ryzen 3xxx series
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080 or RX 6600
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Integrated GPUs require additional 2GB of system RAM. These estimates may change in the final release.
